name: @piprail/example-sdk-sandbox
description: End-to-end test harness for @piprail/sdk — exercises the accept side (createPaymentGate/requirePayment), the pay side (PipRailClient), the spend policy, the wire codecs, the typed errors, and a real on-chain round-trip. Living proof the SDK works.
comment: Suites 07/08/exact-chains/live-exact import the LOCAL ../../../sdk/dist (run `npm run build` in sdk/ first), so they test working-tree code. 07 (Anvil) + 08 (@x402 reference client) need Foundry's anvil; live-exact needs ../../../.secrets and spends real Base USDC (tiny).
